name: Innate
description: The Trait comes with the character's kind — something every member of their race or species has.

name: Magic
description: The Trait is magical, divine, infernal or otherwise from beyond the ordinary world.

name: Psychic
description: The Trait wells up from a mental or mystical source inside the character.

name: Super
description: The Trait comes from a mutation or a one-off alteration particular to this character.

name: Tech
description: The Trait is mechanical or technological.

name: Trained
description: The Trait was built up by practice, study or training.
